title: Park Maui paid and resident parking rules
summary: The council passed Bill 68, CD1 (2026) on second and final reading on July 24, updating Park Maui paid and permit parking zones. It had passed first reading 9–0 on July 7. The bill creates paid parking zones at three Lahaina lots, gives Hawaiʻi residents with a valid license the first two hours free at the Wailuku Garage, and removes a Kamaʻole Beach 3 dirt area from resident-only hours.

timeline.text: Bill 68, CD1 (2026), parking regulations: The council passed a bill updating Park Maui paid and permit parking zones on second and final reading.
Bill 68, updating West Maui parking rules, passed first reading 9–0.
The bill now goes to the full council.
